It also pushes 'Continue cancelling' below bolded offer buttons, so cancelling no longer has equal weight, and it cites the FTC click-to-cancel rule as if it were in force, though a court vacated it in 2025. It also moves 'Continue cancelling' below bolded offer buttons, which makes it less prominent than the other options, even though A says it avoided dark patterns.
